what: R14 + R15 from query-unify-port (01211, 01212), settled in docs/v2/plan/lanes/db/query-unify.md (contract: Storage, LRU and eviction, Function, plumbing). R14: `pub fn resume_readers(&mut self)` on Storage, clearing clock bit 32 (`*self.clock.get_mut() &= !(1 << 32)`), no view, no sweep; test: stop_readers then resume_readers gives readers_stopped() false and a query runs without PendingWrite, view unchanged. R15: the lru cap becomes runtime: FnTable<F> holds `cap: AtomicUsize` starting at F::LRU; register for sweep (`add_lru` in FnTable::new and `Vtable::sweep`) when F::EVICTABLE, not F::LRU > 0; `sweep::<F>` returns when cap == 0 or held <= cap and uses cap for `over`; new `pub fn plumbing::set_lru_capacity<F: Function>(db: &mut F::Db, capacity: usize)` that creates the table if absent and stores the cap (applied at the next view); asserts F::EVICTABLE. Test: lru = 2 function, set_lru_capacity(4), 6 keys run, new view, 4 values held; set 0, new view, nothing evicted. The cap is read only in sweep, never on a hit.
